content:
{
  "markdown": "- History of hypersensitivity to any component of Drug X or docetaxel, or to other taxanes (e.g., paclitaxel) [TBD: confirm cross-reactivity criteria]
- Prior treatment with Drug X or any agent with the same mechanism of action [TBD: specify mechanism if known]
- Active central nervous system (CNS) metastases, as indicated by clinical symptoms, cerebral edema, or progressive growth; patients with treated, stable CNS metastases (no steroids for ≥ 2 weeks, no progression for ≥ 4 weeks) may be eligible [TBD: confirm stability window]
- Known leptomeningeal disease
- Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressive therapy within the past 2 years (except vitiligo, resolved childhood asthma/atopy, or endocrinopathies managed with replacement hormones)
- History of allogeneic organ or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
- Active infection requiring systemic therapy within 2 weeks prior to first dose
- Known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection with detectable viral load or CD4+ count < 350 cells/μL [TBD: specify threshold]
- Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection (positive HBV surface antigen or detectable HCV RNA)
- Inadequate bone marrow function: absolute neutrophil count < 1.5 × 10^9/L, platelet count < 100 × 10^9/L, hemoglobin < 9 g/dL
- Inadequate hepatic function: total bilirubin > 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) (unless due to Gilbert's syndrome), AST/ALT > 2.5 × ULN (or > 5 × ULN if liver metastases present)
- Inadequate renal function: serum creatinine > 1.5 × ULN or creatinine clearance < 60 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault)
- Clinically significant cardiovascular disease, including myocardial infarction, unstable angina, congestive heart failure (NYHA class III or IV), or uncontrolled hypertension within 6 months prior to first dose [TBD: specify parameters]
- Prolonged QT interval (QTcF > 480 ms) or history of torsades de pointes [TBD: confirm threshold]
- Major surgery within 4 weeks prior to first dose
- Active bleeding diathesis or need for anticoagulation with warfarin or direct thrombin inhibitors (low-dose prophylactic anticoagulants allowed if stable)
- Pregnant or breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant during the study; women of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception during treatment and for at least 6 months after last dose; men must use barrier contraception during treatment and for at least 6 months after last dose [TBD: confirm duration]
- Any other malignancy within the past 2 years, except adequately treated basal or squamous cell skin cancer, carcinoma in situ of the cervix, or other in situ carcinoma [TBD: confirm exceptions]
- Known psychiatric or substance abuse disorder that would interfere with compliance or safety
- Inability to comply with study procedures or follow-up visits
- Prior chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or investigational therapy within 4 weeks (or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer) prior to first dose; prior docetaxel is not allowed [TBD: confirm washout]
- Residual toxicity from prior therapy > Grade 1 (except alopecia or peripheral neuropathy ≤ Grade 2) [TBD: confirm grade]
- Known allergy to any excipient of Drug X or docetaxel formulation
- Life expectancy < 3 months [TBD: confirm threshold]
- ECOG performance status > 1 [TBD: confirm if ECOG 2 is allowed per similar trials]
- History of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis requiring steroids
- Active infection with SARS-CoV-2 or COVID-19 within 4 weeks prior to first dose [TBD: confirm window]
- Receipt of live vaccine within 30 days prior to first dose
- Known positive test for tuberculosis (e.g., QuantiFERON) without prior treatment [TBD: specify management]
- Any condition that, in the investigator's judgment, would place the patient at undue risk or interfere with study objectives [TBD: medical decision]
"
}
